Subject: Prep: onsite workshop (Mar 12) — badges, escorts, and pre-reqs

Hi Jill / Security team,

Thanks again for hosting the executive workshop at your SF office on March 12. We want to confirm visitor access requirements so the day runs smoothly. A few specific asks: 

- What information do you need for pre-registration (full name, DOB, license plate, employer)?
- Do you require signed NDAs or a site-specific confidentiality form prior to arrival?
- Are Redwood attendees allowed to bring company laptops and mobile devices unescorted, or is escorting required for certain areas?
- Is there a separate badge for contractors/vendors vs. guests? Any color-coding or limited-area restrictions we should know about?
- Parking/valet instructions and expected badge pickup time (we expect arrivals between 8:00–9:00am).

I'm attaching the attendee list template and our COI for your records. We'll finalize the attendee names by Mar 2.

Attachments: attendee_list.csv (template), Redwood_Certificate_of_Insurance.pdf

Appreciate the quick guidance so we can collect the right fields from our team.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0193

From: Jill Park <jill.park@acme.com>

Subject: Re: Prep: onsite workshop (Mar 12) — badges, escorts, and pre-reqs

Hi Stephanie — great to hear from you. See answers below and attached the site entry packet.

1) Pre-registration fields: full legal name, date of birth (MM/DD/YYYY), government ID type & number (driver's license/passport), employer, mobile number, and license plate (if driving). We need that for the clearance list 72 hours prior.
2) NDA: for executive briefing rooms we require a standard non-disclosure addendum; attendees who will view restricted financial dashboards must sign it. We can accept DocuSign prior to arrival or bring printed copies to sign on-site.
3) Devices: personal/company laptops are fine in public meeting spaces. Access to secure ops floor requires escort and a temporary restricted badge. No removable media is allowed without pre-approval from Acme IT.
4) Badges: guest badges (orange) are for general visitors; contractor/vendor badges (blue) require contractor agreement and background verification. Temporary badges expire at 6:00pm the same day.
5) Parking: self-park in the 2nd Street garage (validation code: ACME-RT). Plan for badge pickup at the security desk between 7:45–8:30am.

Please send the finalized attendee list by Tue, Mar 10 (so we can run background checks where required).

Attached: Acme_Site_Entry_Packet.pdf (includes NDA link and escort policy), SecureEntry_onboarding_instructions.pdf

Best,
Jill Park
Senior Program Manager, Facilities & Security | Acme Financial
jill.park@acme.com | +1 (415) 555-6234

- We have one contractor (Marcus Lin) who will be onsite and is not a Redwood W-2. Does the background verification you mention apply to short-term contractors (<2 weeks)? If so, what is the turnaround?
- Marcus will bring a demo laptop that contains customer anonymized logs. Is there a process for pre-approval of device content or a sandboxed network for demos?
- For plate/ID collection, is that data purged after the event? Any retention policy we should be aware of for privacy compliance?

Rachel and I will compile the attendee list today and upload the filled badge forms — attaching the CSV in this reply.

Subject: Re: Prep: onsite workshop (Mar 12) — badges, escorts, and pre-reqs

Hi Dev / Stephanie — answering Dev's questions: 

- Contractors: short-term contractors do require an ID verification and basic background screen (identity & sanctions check). Typical turnaround is 24–48 hours after we receive the completed form and scanned ID. If Marcus submits tonight we can clear him before Mar 12.
- Devices: we have a guest VLAN for demos that prevents access to internal systems and blocks USB mass storage by policy. If the demo contains sensitive customer-derived logs, please ensure they are redacted or bring a sanitized dataset. Pre-approval for any removable media is required 72 hours prior.
- Data retention: license plate and ID numbers are retained for 30 days, then purged per our privacy policy. We can provide a retention statement for your security/compliance team.

Please use our SecureEntry onboarding link to upload forms and IDs: https://secureentry.example.com/onboarding?company=acme. If you need a DocuSign for the NDA, reply and we’ll send one to the attendee list.

Regards,
Acme Security Ops
security-ops@acme.com
